Problem Summary:
 We can't add a primary key when the table's pk_is_handle is true.

Proposal: [xxx](url) <!-- REMOVE this line if not applicable -->

issue_context.title: could add primary key on a table which already has pk when set alter-primary-key  from false to true
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
1. set `alter-primary-key=false`  and create table with primary key.
``` sql
mysql > create table t1(a int primary key);
Query OK, 0 rows affected
Time: 0.374s
mysql > create table t2 (a int, b int);
Query OK, 0 rows affected
Time: 0.372s
mysql > create table t3 (a int primary key,  b int);
Query OK, 0 rows affected
Time: 0.389s
mysql > alter table t1 add primary key (a);
(1105, 'Unsupported add primary key, alter-primary-key is false')
mysql > alter table t2 add primary key (a);
(1105, 'Unsupported add primary key, alter-primary-key is false')
mysql > alter table t3 add primary key (b);
(1105, 'Unsupported add primary key, alter-primary-key is false')
```

2. set `alter-primary-key=true` and add primary
```sql
alter table t1 add primary key (a);
alter table t2 add primary key (a);
alter table t3 add primary key (b);
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
Can not add primary key while a table already has primary key after setting `alter-primary-key = true`
```sql
mysql > alter table t1 add primary key (a);
(1068, 'Multiple primary key defined')
mysql > alter table t2 add primary key (a);
Query OK, 0 rows affected
Time: 0.139s
mysql > alter table t3 add primary key (b);
(1068, 'Multiple primary key defined')
mysql root@172.16.4.131:test>

```
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
could add primary key  multiple.
```sql
mysql > alter table t1 add primary key (a);
Query OK, 0 rows affected
Time: 0.745s
mysql > alter table t2 add primary key (a);
Query OK, 0 rows affected
Time: 0.822s
mysql > alter table t3 add primary key (b);
Query OK, 0 rows affected
Time: 0.867s
mysql > show create table t1;
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Table | Create Table                                                |
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| t1    | CREATE TABLE `t1` (                                         |
|       |   `a` int(11) NOT NULL,                                     |
|       |   PRIMARY KEY (`a`),                                        |
|       |   PRIMARY KEY (`a`)                                         |
|       | ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin |
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------+

1 row in set
Time: 0.073s
mysql > show create table t2;
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Table | Create Table                                                |
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| t2    | CREATE TABLE `t2` (                                         |
|       |   `a` int(11) NOT NULL,                                     |
|       |   `b` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,                                 |
|       |   PRIMARY KEY (`a`)                                         |
|       | ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin |
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------+

1 row in set
Time: 0.020s
mysql > show create table t3;
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Table | Create Table                                                |
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| t3    | CREATE TABLE `t3` (                                         |
|       |   `a` int(11) NOT NULL,                                     |
|       |   `b` int(11) NOT NULL,                                     |
|       |   PRIMARY KEY (`b`),                                        |
|       |   PRIMARY KEY (`b`)                                         |
|       | ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin |
+-------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```
